decisions.statement: The frame budget is read from the frame rate the game reports.
A console budget is read from the addon CPU time the game allows each frame.
A job raising an error is handed to the error step of that job.
A job with no error step suspends and the error is raised again.
A job marked once per frame runs no more than once in a frame.
A frame that overran is paid back out of the next frame.

definition: how much of each frame the jobs are given and which job runs next
